title: Water Parks for Families: UK, Europe and the USA
description: The best water parks for families: indoor water parks in the UK and Europe, outdoor slides in Tenerife and Orlando, local pools and safety tips.
intro: Flumes, lazy rivers and wave pools: water parks are pure joy in any weather if you go indoors. Here are the best family water parks, near and far.

image.alt: Water slides at a water park

blocks.title: Scout’s water park verdict
blocks.text: Indoor water parks are the ultimate rainy-day rescue. Outdoors, arrive early for a sunbed and slap on the suncream.

sections.html:
• Check height limits on the biggest slides before you promise anything.
  • Bring flip-flops, a waterproof phone pouch and a padlock for lockers.
  • Younger children should wear arm bands or a swim vest if they can’t swim confidently, and always need supervision.

More in our water parks guide.

faqs.q: What is the best indoor water park in the UK?
faqs.a: Popular choices include Sandcastle Waterpark in Blackpool and the indoor pools at Center Parcs villages. Many local leisure centres also have flumes and wave machines.
